name: Instant Pillar Greater
body:
School transmutation [earth]; Level cleric/oracle 3, druid/shaman 3

EFFECT

Area 15-ft. radius burst

DESCRIPTION

As instant pillar, except it creates a separate pillar in each square in the area of effect. The space between them is small, but drains away water, mud, liquids, and heavy gasses. Gaseous creatures can take full cover between the burst pillars.
